title: Abdominal pain
personality: A little scared, holds his belly, answers briefly
chief_complaint: Doctor, my belly has hurt badly since the night, on the lower right.
history_present_illness: The pain started yesterday at about 10 pm around the belly button, dull. By the morning it moved to the lower right part of the belly, became constant and stronger. It gets worse when I walk, cough or when the car shakes. I took a No-Spa tablet, it did not help.

symptoms.name: abdominal pain
symptoms.details: first around the navel, a few hours later moved to the lower right; constant, aching, 7 out of 10; worse when walking and coughing

symptoms.name: vomiting
symptoms.details: once in the morning, food, no relief

symptoms.name: loss of appetite
symptoms.details: since yesterday evening does not want to eat

past_medical_history: Chickenpox in childhood. No operations. No chronic diseases.
medications: Nothing regularly. Took one tablet of No-Spa (drotaverine) yesterday.
family_history: Father has high blood pressure. Does not know about other diseases.
social_history: Does not smoke. Alcohol rarely, on holidays. Lives in a dormitory.

test_results.General inspection: Moderate condition. Lies on the right side with legs drawn up. Tongue dry with white coating.
test_results.Abdominal palpation: Tenderness and muscle guarding in the right iliac fossa. Positive Shchetkin-Blumberg (rebound), Rovsing, Sitkovsky and Bartomier-Michelson signs. Pasternatsky sign negative on both sides.
test_results.Complete blood count: WBC 14.2 ×10⁹/L, neutrophils 82%, band forms 10%. Hb 148 g/L, platelets 260 ×10⁹/L.
test_results.Urinalysis: Straw-coloured, specific gravity 1.020, protein absent, WBC 1-2 per field, RBC 0-1 per field. No bacteria.
test_results.Abdominal ultrasound: Non-compressible tubular structure 9 mm in diameter in the right iliac region, periappendiceal fat thickened, small amount of fluid nearby. Kidneys without dilatation, no stones.
